name: phase2_baselines_established
description: Phase 2 cutover: one count per historical baseline established (the supplier-finance baseline info line, and the client receipt baseline info line). Counts only; extracts nothing (the receipt line also carries a cents total, which is never read here). For verification; no alert reads it.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name=("createvariation" OR "updatevariationdraft" OR "approvevariation" OR "applyvariationcommitment" OR "progressclaimoperation" OR "supplierinvoiceoperation" OR "suppliersettlementoperation" OR "postclientrefund" OR "voidclientrefund" OR "postclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientinvoice" OR "contractvalueoperation" OR "estimateoperation" OR "postclientcreditnote" OR "voidclientcreditnote" OR "postclientretentionrelease" OR "voidclientretentionrelease" OR "postclientreceipt" OR "voidclientreceipt" OR "transferboqtobudget" OR "approvefinalaccount") AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stdout") AND jsonPayload.message=("supplier-finance baseline" OR "client receipt baseline established")
